description: Bug report from a consumer of agent-harness: our cost report marked a trial as fully priced, but its token counts were incomplete. The result came from agent-harness and passed contract.validate_result with usage_completeness "complete", although its usage summary had null cache token counts. A result that claims complete usage must be fully priceable. Find out which results are wrongly accepted as complete and fix agent-harness. Keep the golden contract fixtures valid. Change src/agent_harness/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.9 stdlib; base tree = agent-harness af994d7 without .github, no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_contract tests.test_boundaries (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: agent-harness commit 2ada5ffe25c5b95e42842577b494cc5dd69cff8e (fix(contract): require integer units for complete usage, 2026-10-05), base = its parent af994d7; reference/good.patch is that commit's src diff; hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark from the commit's test change (2026-10-10). Public repository, created after typical model training cutoffs but readable online: contamination possible for models with browsing or later training data; bug-report variant: description states symptoms only (AB5-07 A2, 2026-10-11)
